# Chartologic

> Chartologic is a financial market education and mentorship platform that teaches students, investors, and working professionals the mechanics of Stocks, Forex, Cryptocurrencies, and Derivatives through structured learning, risk management frameworks, and practical market exposure.

## Core Offerings

- [Live Financial Markets Workshop](https://www.chartologic.com/#register): Interactive live masterclass covering price action, risk management, and market fundamentals.
- [Chartologic Trading Residency](https://www.chartologic.com/programs): A structured 6-month curriculum covering multi-asset analysis, risk models, and practical evaluations.
- [Educational Roadmap](https://www.chartologic.com/#roadmap): 8-step structured path from foundational concepts to cohort graduation.
- [Market Scope](https://www.chartologic.com/#markets): In-depth training on Indian & global equities, foreign exchange, and digital assets.
- [Credential Verification Portal](https://www.chartologic.com/verify): Instant online audit for digital certificates issued by Chartologic.

## Key Information

- **Website**: https://www.chartologic.com
- **Target Audience**: College students, working professionals, homemakers, and aspiring traders.
- **Instructors**: NISM-certified educators and experienced market practitioners with over 6+ years of active participation.
- **Support & Inquiries**: support@chartologic.com
- **Contact & WhatsApp**: +91 7595 881 240
- **Headquarters**: Mumbai / Kolkata, India
